description: Between 12 and 15 sentry HP, where the wider sweep went from holding two games in three to a lockout: is it a cliff or a slope? 12 is the shipped value and the baseline; 13, 14 and 15 step through it at 120 runs so a ten-point difference is readable. What the table showed: a slope of about ten points per HP (69%, 80%, 91%, 98%) and no change in pace, so 13 is the value for a garrison that usually holds while the rush still has a real shot. The assertions pin the ends; read the deltas table for the slope.
